{"notes": "Visit 4, left at 7:00. Only what I saw and heard; I still don't know who placed which domino.

Picture: one unbroken dark chain from START (~28,4) along the top to the nose (~4.5,11), then back along the bottom to the tail tip (~27,15.3). No pale pieces or gaps, no strays, and the nose joint looks intact. The fish looks finished and fully connected, and nobody was touching it while I was there.

Omar: Said twice 'fish looks great, hands off, let the clock run out.' Leaving a complete, connected fish alone is a sensible call, but the message was repeated and I saw no new work or check. His earlier tail extension (verified) and his warning about the nose joint remain his real contributions. Still solid on execution, collaboration and impact. No leadership evidence beyond calling the stop.

Sofia: Silent this visit. Earlier she cleared the three nose strays without breaking the joint and handed the tail to Omar cleanly. The planned whole-fish check was never seen. Still solid, with no concerns. Jack's 'sounds good, Sofia' puzzles me, since I didn't hear her speak. Ask what she said.

Jack: Only cheerleading ('great teamwork, proper fish'). He said earlier he'd watch the bottom line for gaps, but Omar caught the shortfall. Four visits and no verified output. Execution and impact remain unrated. Ask him directly what he built or checked.

Hana: Silent across all four visits. I saw nothing and have no basis for any rating. Ask her directly.

Before final ratings: ask each person privately who built what, who inspected the whole fish, and who found the tail shortfall. Don't rate Jack or Hana on the cheerleading or on the finished fish alone."}
